description: We are a closed team of enthusiastic A-Level students from Peshawar participating in our first NASA Space Apps Challenge! We are tackling the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge, combining deep research into NASA's historic missions with creative storytelling to showcase the equipment left behind on the Moon, Mars, and deep space—and the incredible science they made possible. Our team is complete, and we are excited to build and present our project at City University
summary: Abandoned, But Not Forgotten is an interactive web museum built by Team Starlight Archivist to make NASA's historic robotic missions accessible and engaging for school-age students. Instead of dense technical archives, young explorers discover 40 retired spacecraft across the Moon, Mars, Venus, and deep space through first-person artifact diaries, an 8-chapter Story Mode, and an interactive Space Cadet Quiz.
details: How It Works: Our interactive web platform transforms archival data from 40 historic NASA spacecraft into an immersive digital museum. Users can filter missions by celestial destination (Moon, Mars, Venus, Asteroids, and Deep Space), read first-person artifact diaries written from the perspective of each probe, experience an 8-chapter narrative Story Mode, explore an engineering guide explaining why spacecraft are left behind, and test their knowledge with the Space Cadet Quiz. Tools & Tech Stack: Built as a responsive, single-page web application using HTML5, Tailwind CSS, and vanilla JavaScript, hosted via GitHub Pages.
